sections.title: Barcelona
sections.markdown: We started our trip in Barcelona, a city known for its art, architecture, and food. We spent our days exploring the city and trying all the different foods. It was a great way to start our trip.

sections.title: Lisbon
sections.markdown: We then traveled to Lisbon, a city known for its history, culture, and food. We spent our days exploring the city and trying all the different foods. It was a great way to continue our trip.
